title_en: GTA 6 Launch Live Blog: All the News as It Happens From the Biggest Entertainment Release of All Time
summary_en: 13 years after GTA 5 came out, GTA 6 is finally upon us, and IGN is reporting on the launch live right here.
body_en:
13 years after GTA 5 came out, GTA 6 is finally upon us, and we'll be reporting on the launch live right here.
Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 goes live at midnight local time, as the clock strikes November 19, which means some parts of the world get the game earlier than others. It is thought that millions of fans will make use of what's called the 'New Zealand trick' to play up to a day early, and we've got a breakdown of how it works right here .
Otherwise, it's a case of waiting for GTA 6 to unlock at midnight tonight wherever you are in the world. But you can be sure that there will be plenty of news on the game, its fans, and the impending launch before then. Already this morning we've had an official warning from Sony to update the PS5 to the latest firmware update , which we now know is required to play GTA 6.
GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, and some companies have even given staff bonus time off to play it . Have you booked time off to play? Let us know in the poll below. Meanwhile, schools are preparing for mass absences among pupils by issuing warnings to parents — with some even offering children the chance to win gift cards just for turning up .
While you wait, we've got some great articles to help you through the hours ahead, including Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life Grand Theft Auto Research , and — finally — confirmation of the actress who plays Lucia .
IGN will have live updates on all things GTA 6 below:
It may have been 13 years since a GTA, but, of course, in that time Rockstar has released Red Dead Redemption 2. It's my favourite game of all time, and I'm sure I'm not alone in thinking that. Surely GTA 6 can't top it? Surely.
Remember when life felt so much simpler back in 2013? I had just left university and remember eagerly awaiting GTA 5. Here's our review of that game from 13 years ago. Time really has flown.
It's almost time... if you're a permanent or temporary resident of New Zealand, that is. One hour left until GTA 6 launches. After many, many years of waiting, we're finally here.
I'm Simon and I'll be with you in the build-up to release to join in with all of the excitement and report on all of the news surrounding what feels like the biggest game launch ever. Let's have some fun.
